messages:
sam: Quick design check: compact scorecard + bulk-approve flow. Users say they lose the reviewer gist after approve. Need a lightweight pattern to preserve the 'why' without blowing density.
anya: Could we surface a 1-word gist pill and include that text in the approval snackbar/toast? That way context travels with the action.
kevin: I like pill + toast. Pill = bold single word (e.g. 'brevity'). Toast = 'Approved 4 items — Note: "brevity" (open to view)'. Make toast role=status polite.
lina: Accessibility: ensure the pill has an accessible name (aria-label) and small toggle to open the full note. SR users must be able to read full note even when visual truncated.
a11y-bot: a11y nits: add aria-controls on toggle, use aria-expanded, and announce toast with polite live region: `Approval recorded for {n} items. Reviewer note preview: {summary}`. Also restore focus to nearest diff after approve.
sam: Microcopy variants for the primary CTA: A) "Confirm approval" B) "Approve and record" C) "Approve (no note)". Which reduces accidental clicks?
anya: Test A vs C. A is neutral, C is explicit. Also add helper text on CTA focus: 'Press Enter to add a note, Ctrl+Enter to confirm'.
kevin: Keyboard flow: Enter opens inline note; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submits. Also provide Shift+Undo window (10s snackbar).
lina: For compact avatars show initials only but ensure modal shows full name. SR should always read full name in modal via aria-label.
a11y-bot: Also recommend truncating preview by words not chars in toast and include first 80 chars in modal.
sam: Action items: 1) Design to produce pill + toast mock (2 variants: pill weight high vs model score weight high) 2) Eng to prototype Enter->open, Ctrl+Enter->submit, 10s undo snackbar 3) a11y to draft exact aria text. I'll collect mocks and run a 5-person keyboard-first check.
anya: Dropping figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-gist-toast-001
kevin: I'll prototype in storybook and share.
lina: I'll write aria snippets in PRD.
sam: Thanks team — want to keep density but not lose intent. Follow up tomorrow. :sparkles:
